reuse.why: Every step goes through the tree's existing applyWeekendRule/getDateWithSkippedWeekend; the new range handler reuses applyWeekendRule just like getUpcomingDates.

duplication.why: Weekend, daily-skip and holiday logic is written once in shared/schedules.ts; getDatesInRange and getUpcomingDates share only the small RSchedule/occurrences scaffolding.

placement.why: Rules live in shared/schedules.ts, the handler in server/schedules/app.ts, and schedule-template only consumes the helper.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps; the schedule-template loop rewrite is needed to handle null days and stays local.

maintainability.why: Single decision point (applyWeekendRule returning null for skipped days) with a named shift bound; small magic numbers (take: 7, count * 7) are commented.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template all call applyWeekendRule

abstraction_drift.where: applyWeekendRule's rule gains frequency and holidays and getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains holidays; one daily branch inside applyWeekendRule; these model the requested variation and no call site bypasses the helper
